<module id="adder_pipe_64bit">
    <description>A 64-bit ripple carry adder implemented with pipelining stages.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock input.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="i_en">Enable signal for addition operation.</input>
        <input id="adda" width_description="[63:0]">64-bit input operand A.</input>
        <input id="addb" width_description="[63:0]">64-bit input operand B.</input>
        <output id="result" width_description="[64:0]">65-bit output representing the sum of adda and addb.</output>
        <output id="o_en">Output enable signal indicating the availability of the result.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>
        // Registers for pipeline stages
        reg [63:0] adda_reg;
        reg [63:0] addb_reg;
        reg i_en_reg;
        
        reg [63:0] sum_stage1_reg;
        reg c_out_stage1_reg;
        reg [63:0] sum_stage2_reg;
        reg c_out_stage2_reg;
        reg [63:0] sum_stage3_reg;
        reg c_out_stage3_reg;
        
        reg [63:0] sum_stage4_reg;
        reg c_out_stage4_reg;
        
        reg o_en_reg;
        
        // Synchronize input enable signal
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                i_en_reg <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                i_en_reg <= i_en;
            end
        end
        
        // Pipeline stage 1
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                adda_reg <= 64'd0;
                addb_reg <= 64'd0;
            end else if (i_en_reg) begin
                adda_reg <= adda;
                addb_reg <= addb;
            end
        end
        
        // Calculate sum and carry-out for pipeline stage 1
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                sum_stage1_reg <= 64'd0;
                c_out_stage1_reg <= 1'b0;
            end else if (i_en_reg) begin
                {c_out_stage1_reg, sum_stage1_reg} <= adda_reg + addb_reg;
            end
        end
        
        // Pipeline stage 2
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                sum_stage2_reg <= 64'd0;
                c_out_stage2_reg <= 1'b0;
            end else if (i_en_reg) begin
                sum_stage2_reg <= sum_stage1_reg;
                c_out_stage2_reg <= c_out_stage1_reg;
            end
        end
        
        // Pipeline stage 3
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                sum_stage3_reg <= 64'd0;
                c_out_stage3_reg <= 1'b0;
            end else if (i_en_reg) begin
                sum_stage3_reg <= sum_stage2_reg;
                c_out_stage3_reg <= c_out_stage2_reg;
            end
        end
        
        // Pipeline stage 4
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                sum_stage4_reg <= 64'd0;
                c_out_stage4_reg <= 1'b0;
            end else if (i_en_reg) begin
                sum_stage4_reg <= sum_stage3_reg;
                c_out_stage4_reg <= c_out_stage3_reg;
            end
        end
        
        // Output enable signal generation
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                o_en_reg <= 1'b0;
            end else if (i_en_reg) begin
                o_en_reg <= 1'b1;
            end else begin
                o_en_reg <= 1'b0;
            end
        end
        
        // Assign outputs
        assign result = {c_out_stage4_reg, sum_stage4_reg};
        assign o_en = o_en_reg;
    </implementation>
</module>
